data.one_liner: A command-line tool for developing and deploying web applications with Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a local web development server with a file system watcher to rebuild on changes. Includes features for debugging web apps, launching in Chrome, and building applications for deployment.
use_when: You are developing a web application with Dart.
You need a local development server with file watching and automatic rebuilds.
avoid_when: You are building non-web Dart applications (like mobile or desktop).
You want to use it as a library dependency instead of activating it globally.
strengths: Integrates debugging features and DevTools support for Dart web apps.
Supports automatic page refresh and module reloading.
weaknesses: Not meant to be used as a package dependency, must be globally activated.
Requires specific build_runner and build_web_compilers setup.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `dart pub global activate webdev` and configure dev_dependencies like build_runner and build_web_compilers in pubspec.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate webdev
webdev serve
